name: mesoscope
description: Agentic access to the Mesoscope-VR reference acquisition system. Currently covers the sollertia-experiment system-specific layer: the hardware subsystem inventory and MesoscopeSystemConfiguration, the runtime state machine, orchestrator, UIs, and `sle mesoscope` CLI, and the per-session Zaber and Mesoscope position snapshots. Optional system-specific companion to the core plugins; relies on the sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp) registered by the experiment plugin, which it requires.
